note: Read 2026-10-30 on island.is, the government's portal, for the district commissioners. The driving age is 17, and the first licence is a provisional one (bráðabirgðaskírteini) valid for 3 years at 4,300 krónur; after at least a year on it, with the third driving-school course and a driving assessment and no penalty points, a full licence (fullnaðarskírteini) can be had, at 8,600 krónur, valid for 15 years at a time. So the full licence is kept from 18, at 8,600 krónur and 15 years; the provisional one isn't held. The identity card (nafnskírteini), which the same offices issue, is the ids engine's, not held here. No exchange list was read.

sources.title: Ísland.is, Umsókn um námsheimild og fyrsta ökuskírteini
sources.said: Á Íslandi er bílprófsaldur 17 ár ... Fyrsta ökuskírteinið er bráðabirgðaskírteini og gildir í 3 ár. ... þá má leggja inn umsókn um fullnaðarskírteini einu ári eftir útgáfu bráðabirgðaskírteinis. Fullnaðarskírteini gildir í 15 ár í senn.

sources.title: Ísland.is, Umsókn um fullnaðarskírteini
sources.said: hafa verið með bráðabirgðaskírteini í að minnsta kosti eitt ár ... Fullnaðarskírteini kostar 8.600 krónur .
